originalTitle: Nigeria's president orders manhunt after kidnappers upload victim video
title: A Helping Hand in Nigeria!
content:
Hello, my amazing friends! Your friendly African news reporter is here to share an important story with you today. Today, we're talking about something happening in a big, beautiful country called Nigeria. Nigeria is in Africa, just like where you are! Sometimes, even in lovely places, a little problem can happen. But guess what? We have wonderful grown-ups, like our President, who are always ready to help!

A Little Puzzle in the Forest

Imagine you are playing outside, maybe in a park or near some trees. Well, in Nigeria, some people – grown-ups, boys, and girls, just like you – were taken away from their homes. They were in a big place with lots of trees, like a forest. This made many people sad and worried. It's like when your favourite toy goes missing, and you really, really want to find it! Someone showed a video, a moving picture, of these people in the forest. The video helped everyone see where they might be, which was a very important clue. **Did you know?** Nigeria is famous for its bright and colourful fabrics, like 'Ankara'! People wear them to parties and celebrations, and they look so beautiful!

The President's Big Heart

Now, here's the good news! The President of Nigeria heard about this. A President is like the main grown-up in charge of a country. They help everyone and make sure things are safe and fair for all the people who live there. Our President has a very big heart and cares about every single person in Nigeria, young and old. When he saw the video, he knew he had to do something right away. He said, "We must find our friends and family! We must bring them home safely!" He didn't just sit and watch. He stood up and said, "Let's go find them!" He wants to make sure everyone feels protected and loved. **Did you know?** The President lives in a very special house called the 'Presidential Villa' in the capital city, Abuja! It's where he works hard to make good plans for the country.

A Special Search is On!

So, what did the President do? He asked all the clever and brave people to start a very special search. Imagine if your puppy or kitten ran away, and everyone in your family helped to look for it. That's what's happening! Soldiers, police officers, and other brave helpers are now looking everywhere. They are searching in the forests, looking at clues, and working very, very hard day and night. Their job is to make sure everyone is safe and sound. They want to bring all the men, women, and children back to their families, where they belong. It's like a big team working together to solve a puzzle and make everyone happy again. **Did you know?** Nigeria is home to many different kinds of amazing animals, like elephants, lions, and even gorillas! These animals live in big natural parks across the country.

Why Safety is So Important

This story reminds us that safety is super important. Safety means being protected from harm or danger, like wearing a helmet when you ride your bike or holding a grown-up's hand when you cross the road. Our grown-ups, like our parents, teachers, and guardians, always try their very best to keep us safe. It's good to always stay with your family or friends when you are out playing or exploring. And if you ever feel lost or scared, always tell a trusted grown-up right away. They are there to help you, just like the President is helping the people in Nigeria. They are your superheroes! **Did you know?** Nigerians love to tell exciting stories and listen to lively music! They have many wonderful festivals with dancing, singing, and colourful parades.

Together We Are Stronger

When something tricky like this happens, it makes us all remember to be kind and help each other. The people of Nigeria are standing together, helping each other, and sharing hope. They are hoping and praying very much for everyone to come home soon. It shows that even when things are a little bit tough, we can always find strength together, like a big, loving family. Just like when you play a game with your friends, you work as a team to win! This big search by the President and his team is a very bright sign of hope. It tells us that no one is forgotten, and everyone matters. **Did you know?** The River Niger is a very long and important river that flows through Nigeria! It helps plants grow and gives water to many animals and people.

A Happy Ending Soon!

We all hope that very, very soon, this special search will have a happy ending. We hope all the men, women, and children will be back with their families, safe and sound in their homes. The President and his helpers are working hard every single day to make this happen. It shows us that good people are always trying to make the world a better and safer place for everyone, especially for children like you. So, let's send our good thoughts and happy wishes to Nigeria and hope for a super happy reunion very, very soon! Thank you for listening, my wonderful friends! Stay safe and keep smiling!
summary: The President of Nigeria has ordered a big search to find many men, women, and children who were seen in a video in a forest, so they can be brought home safely to their families.
whyMatters: This is important because it shows that our leaders care about keeping everyone safe, especially children, and that good people are working together to help those who need it most.

originalTitle: Trump’s Korean gambit exposes a shifting East Asian order
title: Friends and Shields: Big Thoughts in East Asia!
content:
Jambo! That's 'hello' in Swahili, from your friendly news reporter right here in Africa! Today, we're going on a little adventure to a place far, far away, called East Asia. It's a land with beautiful countries and amazing people, just like us. But something big is making them think very hard about how to stay safe and be good friends.

What is a Security Umbrella?

Imagine you are playing outside, and it starts to rain. You have a big, strong umbrella that keeps you dry. Now, imagine a country being that umbrella! A 'security umbrella' is like a promise from a very big and strong country to help smaller countries if they are in trouble. It means they will send their soldiers and help keep everyone safe. America is a super big country, and for a very long time, it has been like a big, helpful friend to many countries in East Asia. They promised to help keep peace and safety. Did you know? Countries have armies to protect their people. Sometimes, a big country's army can help other countries too, like a big brother helping a little brother.

Friends Who Need Help

In East Asia, there are two countries called South Korea and Japan. They are very good friends with America. They like having America's promise to help keep them safe. America even has some of its soldiers living in these countries to show they are serious about helping. South Korea and Japan are amazing places! Japan has bullet trains that go super fast, and South Korea is famous for its delicious food and cool music. For many, many years, America has been like a big, strong shield for them. This made South Korea and Japan feel very secure. They knew if someone tried to cause trouble, America would be there to help.

A Neighbor Who Likes to Be Strong

Now, there's another country very close to South Korea. It's called North Korea. Sometimes, North Korea likes to do things that worry its neighbors. They have special rockets that they like to show off. This is one of the big reasons why South Korea and Japan like having America as their special friend with a big umbrella. It makes them feel safer when North Korea does things that can be a bit scary. Did you know? North and South Korea used to be one country, but now they are two separate countries. They are neighbors but don't always agree.

When Big Leaders Talk

Recently, something very different happened. The President of America, who is a very important leader, talked directly to the leader of North Korea. This was a really big deal because, for a long time, these two leaders didn't talk to each other much. It's like two kids who haven't been playing together for ages suddenly decide to sit down and talk. People wondered what they were talking about and what it would mean for everyone else. These talks made some people in South Korea and Japan wonder: "Hmm, if America is talking directly to North Korea, does that mean America's promise to *us* might change a little bit?" Did you know? Leaders from different countries meet all the time to try and solve problems and make friends! It's called diplomacy!

Thinking Hard About Safety

This is where the 'big thoughts' come in! Because America's leader talked to North Korea, some people in South Korea and Japan started to wonder if their big friend's umbrella might not be as big or strong for them anymore. They started to have 'doubts'. When countries have doubts, they start making 'new plans'. These plans are called 'strategic calculations'. It means they are thinking very hard about how *they* can keep their own people safe. They might think: "Should we make our own armies even stronger?" Or, "Should we try to be better friends with *other* big countries too, just in case?" They are trying to figure out the best way to live in peace. It's like when you're playing a game, and the rules change a little. You have to think about new ways to play so you can still win and have fun! Did you know? Every country in the world wants its people to be safe and happy. That's why leaders spend so much time thinking about peace.

What Happens Next?

No one knows exactly what will happen next. But what we do know is that countries in East Asia are busy thinking. They want to make sure everyone stays safe and happy, no matter what happens with their big friend, America. They might talk more to each other. They might build stronger defenses for themselves. Or they might try to find new ways to be friendly with North Korea, so everyone can live peacefully. It's a bit like when you and your friends grow up and your friendships change a little. You still care about each other, but you might find new ways to be together and help each other. So, from your African reporter, that's the big news from East Asia! It's all about countries trying to stay safe and finding new ways to be friends, because sometimes, even the biggest promises can make everyone think very hard about the future. And that's okay, because thinking helps us find the best path to peace for everyone!
summary: Countries in East Asia, like South Korea and Japan, are thinking hard about how to stay safe because their big friend, America, is changing how it helps them and talks to a country that worried them, North Korea.
whyMatters: It's important because every country wants to keep its people safe, and when big countries change how they protect their friends, other countries need to find new ways to ensure peace and security for everyone.

title: Our African Star Jaouen Joins a Big Team!
content:

Everyone loves watching football, right? We love to cheer for our favourite teams. We love to watch the players run super fast. Today, we are talking about a very special player. He is from our wonderful continent of Africa! His name is Jaouen Hadjam. Say his name with me: Ja-oo-en Had-jam! He is a really talented young man.

Who is Jaouen Hadjam?

Jaouen Hadjam is a fantastic football player. He is 23 years old. That means he is a young adult. He is very strong and fast. Jaouen loves to play football. He has been playing football for a long, long time. He trains very hard every single day. He works on his kicks and his passes. He makes sure he is fit to play. Jaouen is a very good player. He is from a country called Algeria. Algeria is in North Africa. It is a beautiful country. It is part of our big African family. We are so proud of him!

Where is Algeria?

Did you know that Africa is a very big continent? It has many, many different countries. Algeria is one of them! It is in the northern part of Africa. It has sunny deserts and a long, beautiful coastline. People in Algeria love football very much. Just like us! Children play football in the streets. They play football in the parks. Adults watch football on TV. They go to the stadiums to cheer. Jaouen grew up loving football in Algeria. He dreamed of playing for big teams. Now, his dream is coming true! It is so wonderful to see.

What is a "Left-Back"?

In football, players have different jobs. They play in different places on the field. Jaouen Hadjam plays a special job called "left-back." Can you say "left-back"? A left-back plays on the left side of the football field. Their job is very, very important. They help stop the other team from scoring goals. They are like a super shield! They also help their team score goals. They run up and down the side of the field. They pass the ball forward. They send the ball to the players who score goals. It is a lot of running! It needs a lot of skill. Jaouen is very good at being a left-back. He is very fast. He can run for a long, long time. He helps his team a lot.

Meet Brighton & Hove Albion!

Jaouen is joining a brand new team! This team is called Brighton & Hove Albion. It's a long name, right? Let's just call them Brighton for short. Brighton is a football club. They play in a very big league. A league is like a super competition. Many teams play against each other to see who is the best. Brighton is from a country called England. England is very far away from Africa. It is across the big blue sea. But football brings everyone together! Brighton wears blue and white colours. Their team has many good players. They play in a big stadium. Many fans go to watch them play. They cheer very, very loudly for Brighton. Now, Jaouen will wear their blue and white shirt! How cool is that?

Saying Goodbye to Young Boys

Jaouen helped them win many games. He helped them become champions. He was a very important player for them. Now, he is ready for a new adventure. He is ready to play for Brighton. It is sad to say goodbye to old friends. But it is very exciting to make new ones!

A Five-Year Adventure!

Five years is like going from Class 2 all the way to Class 7! He will wear their team colours. He will play many, many games. He will train hard every single day. He will make new friends on the team. He will try his very best to win games for Brighton. This is a very exciting new chapter for him. We hope he scores many goals and makes lots of amazing passes! He will make Africa proud!

African Stars Shining Bright!

Did you know that Jaouen is not the only African player in this big league? No! He is the *third* player from Algeria in this big, famous league! How awesome is that? It means there are many talented players from Africa. They go to play football all over the world. They show everyone how good African players are. They make us all proud. When we see players like Jaouen, it tells us something very important. It tells us that with hard work, we can achieve our dreams. It does not matter where you come from. If you work hard, you can reach for the stars! Jaouen is a shining star. Did you know that football is the most popular sport in the whole world?!

Why We Love Football!

Football is more than just a game. It teaches us so many good things. It teaches us to work as a team. Everyone on the team has to help each other. It teaches us to be fair. It teaches us to never give up. Even if you are losing, you keep trying! It also brings people together. People from different countries. People who speak different languages. They all love football! It is a beautiful game. We love to watch it. We love to play it. It makes us very happy!

Get Ready to Cheer!

So, next time you hear about Brighton playing, remember Jaouen Hadjam! Remember our amazing player from Algeria. He is going to do great things. We will cheer for him from Africa! We will wish him good luck. We are so happy for Jaouen. This is a big step in his football journey. We hope he has so much fun. We hope he helps Brighton win many, many games. Let's send him our big African cheers! Go, Jaouen, go!
summary: African football star Jaouen Hadjam from Algeria, who plays as a left-back, has joined a new big team called Brighton & Hove Albion from England, signing a five-year deal.

originalTitle: China hits out at 'illegal' new US sanctions on Iran and trading partners
title: Oil, Friends, and Big Rules!
content:
Hello from Your News Friend!

Hello, my amazing friends! It's me, your friendly news reporter for Africa! Today, we are going to talk about something very important. It's about countries, oil, and rules! It might sound a little grown-up, but we will make it super easy to understand. Imagine you and your friends are playing a game. Sometimes, there are rules that everyone has to follow. And sometimes, friends might not agree on the rules. This is a little bit like what is happening with some big countries far away.

What is Oil? And Why is it Important?

Let's start with oil! Have you ever wondered how cars move? Or how buses get us to school? Many of them use something called oil, or petrol, or diesel. Oil is like a special liquid that comes from deep, deep under the ground. It's like a treasure hidden underground! It helps to power many things in our world. **Did you know?** Oil was made from tiny plants and animals that lived in the sea millions and millions of years ago! Wow, that's a long, long time! Oil helps us do so many things! It helps to make electricity for our lights. It helps factories make toys and clothes. It even helps airplanes fly high in the sky! So, you see, oil is super, super important for countries and for all of us. Countries need a lot of oil to keep everything running smoothly.

Meet the Countries: Iran, China, and the USA

Now, let's meet some of the countries we are talking about. First, there is a country called **Iran**. Iran is very far away from us, but it has lots of oil under its ground! They have many wells that bring this oil up. Then, there is a big country called **China**. China is also far away. China has many, many people and many, many factories. They need a lot of oil to make their cars go and their factories work. So, China likes to buy oil from countries that have it, like Iran. And then, there is the **USA**, which stands for the United States of America. The USA is another big country. They also have a lot of important things happening there. These countries are all very big and they often talk to each other. Sometimes they are good friends, and sometimes they have disagreements, just like we do with our friends.

Rules for Friends: What are Sanctions?

Imagine you and your friends are playing. If one friend does something that makes others sad or breaks an important rule, sometimes the other friends might say, "We can't play with you right now," or "We won't share our toys with you until you follow the rules." In the world of countries, when a big country like the USA doesn't agree with what another country is doing, they sometimes make "rules." These special rules are called **sanctions**. Sanctions are like saying, "We don't want other countries to do business with this country right now." Doing business means buying and selling things. So, if there are sanctions, it means other countries might not be allowed to buy oil or other things from that country. It's like a "timeout" for business. **Did you know?** Sanctions are a way for countries to try and make another country change its mind about something, without going to war. It's like a big "please stop" message!

The USA's Big Rule About Iran

The USA has made a big rule about Iran. The USA does not want other countries to buy oil from Iran. They have asked many countries to stop buying Iran's oil. They say, "If you keep buying oil from Iran, we might not be able to do business with you either." This is called "isolating" a country. It means trying to make that country feel alone, so it doesn't have many friends to buy things from or sell things to. The USA believes that by doing this, Iran will change some of the things the USA doesn't like.

China's Side of the Story

Now, remember China? China needs a lot of oil to keep its country working. They have been buying a lot of oil from Iran for a long, long time. It's like they have a special arrangement, or a friendship, for buying oil. But now, with the USA's new rules, China is not happy! China thinks it's not fair for the USA to tell other countries who they can buy oil from. China says, "This rule is not right! We want to keep buying oil from our friend Iran. It helps our country, and it helps Iran too." China thinks the USA's rules are "illegal," which means they believe the rules are not allowed or fair. **Did you know?** China is one of the biggest countries in the world, and it needs a lot of energy to power all its homes and factories! So, China is telling the USA that they don't agree with these sanctions. They want to continue their business with Iran. It's like two friends arguing about who can play with whom!

What Does This Mean for Everyone?

When big countries disagree, they often talk a lot. They might try to find a way to agree, or they might just keep doing what they think is right. For now, China is saying "No" to the USA's rules about Iran's oil. This means the USA and China might have more talks. They are like big leaders trying to find the best way forward for their countries and for the world. It's important for countries to talk, even when they disagree, so they can try to be peaceful. **Did you know?** When countries talk to each other to solve problems, it's called "diplomacy"! It's like grown-ups having a serious chat.

Why Do We Care?

This news shows us that countries are all connected, just like we are connected to our friends and family. What happens in one part of the world, even far away, can sometimes affect other parts of the world. For us, it's important to know that countries are always talking and sometimes disagreeing. But talking is good because it helps everyone try to understand each other. And that's our news for today, my wonderful friends! Remember to always be kind to your friends, even when you have different ideas! See you next time!
summary: Big countries like the USA and China are disagreeing about who can buy oil from Iran, with the USA wanting to stop it and China wanting to continue.
whyMatters: It's important because countries need oil for many things, and when big countries disagree, they need to talk to find a peaceful way forward for everyone.

originalTitle: Tottenham agree loan for Man City's Marmoush
title: Big News! Football Fun for Omar!
content:
Hello, Amazing Friends in Africa!

Hello, amazing friends in Africa! It's your favourite news reporter here, bringing you super exciting news from the world of football! We all love football, right? Kicking a ball, running fast, scoring goals – it's the best! Today's story is about a really good football player and two big teams.

Meet Omar Marmoush!

There's a super talented football player named Omar Marmoush. He is a forward. A forward is a player who helps score goals! Omar is very fast and clever with the ball. He used to play for a big team called Manchester City. Manchester City wears sky blue shirts and they are very famous.

Two Famous Teams

Now, Omar is going to play for *another* famous team! This team is called Tottenham Hotspur. Tottenham Hotspur wears white shirts. They are also a very good team and play exciting football. Both of these teams are from a country called England. England is far away from us, across the big ocean. But we still love to watch their games!

What is a 'Loan Deal'?

Our big news is that Omar Marmoush is moving to Tottenham Hotspur. But it's not a normal move. It's called a 'loan deal'. What does that mean? Well, imagine you have a really cool toy, like a special football. Your friend wants to play with it for a while. So, you let your friend borrow it. That's a 'loan'! In football, when a player goes on 'loan', it means they go to play for a new team for some time. They are still owned by their old team, but they play for the new team. So, Omar Marmoush will play for Tottenham Hotspur for a whole season. It's like a long holiday playing for a new team!

Why Do Teams Do Loans?

Teams do loan deals for many reasons. Sometimes a player wants to play more games. Sometimes the new team needs a good player to help them win. It's a way for players to get more experience and help a new team. Everyone is happy! Omar gets to play, and Tottenham gets a great player.

Did You Know?

Did you know that many amazing football players from Africa started playing football on dusty fields, just like some of you? They dreamed big and worked very hard! Players like Mohamed Salah, Sadio Mané, and Didier Drogba are super stars who made their dreams come true!

A Big Promise for Next Year!

This loan deal for Omar Marmoush has a special part. It's called an 'obligation to make the deal permanent'. Wow, that sounds like big words, doesn't it? It just means that Tottenham Hotspur *must* buy Omar Marmoush next summer. It's not a choice, it's a promise! So, Omar will play for Tottenham for one year as a 'loan' player. Then, next year, he will become a full-time Tottenham player forever! He will wear the white shirt for many more years.

A Lot of Money!

When Tottenham buys Omar next summer, they will pay a lot of money. The news says they will pay £60 million! That is a HUGE, HUGE amount of money! Can you imagine how much that is? Let's try to think about it. £60 million is like having a mountain of tasty sweets! Or enough money to buy so many footballs for every child in a whole big town! It shows how much Tottenham Hotspur wants Omar Marmoush to be part of their team for a long time. Good football players are worth a lot of money because they bring so much joy and help their teams win.

Why Is This Exciting?

This is exciting news for many reasons! Omar Marmoush is a great player, and he will help Tottenham Hotspur score more goals. We love to watch exciting matches with lots of goals, right? It's also exciting because it shows how players move between teams. It's like a big family where players sometimes move to a new home. We will get to see Omar play in new colours and help his new team.

Did You Know?

Did you know that the word 'football' is called 'soccer' in some countries, like America? But here in Africa and in most places, we call it football! The rules are the same, no matter what you call it. It’s all about kicking the ball into the net.

Dream Big, Little Stars!

This news about Omar Marmoush reminds us that football is a global game. Players come from all over the world to play in different countries. Maybe one day, one of *you* will be a famous football player! You could be scoring goals in a big stadium and making everyone cheer. Keep practising your kicks, keep running fast, and keep dreaming big! Who knows, maybe your name will be in the news one day, just like Omar Marmoush's! We are so proud of all the African players who play all around the world. Football teaches us about teamwork, working hard, and never giving up. So, let's cheer for Omar Marmoush at his new team, Tottenham Hotspur! We can't wait to see him play. Keep shining, everyone!
summary: Omar Marmoush, a football player from Manchester City, is moving to Tottenham Hotspur on a loan deal, meaning he will play for them for a while, and then Tottenham will buy him permanently next summer for a lot of money.
whyMatters: This is important because Omar Marmoush is a good player who will help Tottenham Hotspur score goals and play exciting football, inspiring kids in Africa to dream about becoming football stars too.
